condition: recombinant DyP-loaded WT T=1 shell expressed in E. coli
method:
cryo-EM; MOLE pore analysis; 
APBS electrostatic analysis
notes:
Five-fold minor pore adjacent to the major five-fold pore; MOLE bottleneck diameter 2.8 ± 0.3 Å. Electrostatics are pH-dependent: exterior and
